## LINK-4 result report

### Summary
Implemented connection detail, provenance-aware retyping, delete confirmation, single-level 8-second undo, and the collapsible board legend. The required tests and typecheck pass, as do lint, the full unit suite, and the production build.

### Files created
- `src/features/connections/ConnectionDetail.tsx`
- `src/features/connections/ConnectionLegend.tsx`
- `src/features/connections/useUndoDeleteConnection.ts`
- `tests/connections/ConnectionDetail.test.tsx`
- `tests/connections/ConnectionLegend.test.tsx`

### Files changed
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.css`
- `src/features/connections/connections.css`

### Acceptance evidence
| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Valid retype updates the existing row without changing the connection ID | **Pass** — integration test asserts the repository row keeps `NOTE_SOURCE_CONNECTION_ID` while its type becomes `provenance`, and the page's `BoardSnapshot` handed to the canvas changes to the same ID with the new type. |
| `CaseBoardPage` mounts `ConnectionDetail` on selection and `ConnectionLegend` in board controls | **Pass** — page test selects the connection in the board store; legend is mounted in the labelled “Board controls” group. |
| Invalid provenance retype is disabled and explains why | **Pass** — note-to-topic provenance radio is disabled, `aria-describedby` points at the visible reason, and the reason explains the Note/Source rule. |
| Delete confirmation names both cards and the type; cancel leaves the connection intact | **Pass** — dialog text includes both titles and `Association`/`Provenance`; cancel leaves the repository row and the detail mounted, and returns focus to the Delete trigger. |
| Undo restores within 8 seconds; timeout and a second delete clear the slot | **Pass** — hook tests cover restore-by-original-ID, the 7,999/8,000 ms boundary, and slot replacement on a second delete. |
| Legend communicates both types without colour alone and is keyboard operable | **Pass** — text says “solid red” and “dashed amber”; CSS asserts `solid` vs `dashed` border patterns; native button toggles with Enter/Space and exposes `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`. |

### Keyboard, focus, and announcements
- Exercise: `Tab` to the radio group, `ArrowDown` to change type, `Enter`/`Space` on the legend toggle, pointer activation of dialogs and buttons via `user-event`.
- Delete confirmation uses the shared `Dialog`: initial focus on “Keep connection”, Tab trap, Escape cancels, focus returns to the Delete trigger.
- Undo toast uses the shared polite `role="status"` Toast. After Undo, focus moves to the restored detail heading so the disappearing action never drops focus to `<body>`.
- Retype failures render a `role="alert"`; provenance eligibility is exposed in a polite status region.
- Target measurement asserted: `.connection-detail__label` and `.nd-button` are at least 44×44 CSS pixels.
- Contrast asserted: legend/detail body text uses `--color-ink-muted` on `--color-surface` at 7.87:1; emphasis text at higher contrast. Association swatch is 3.17:1 against the surface, with a dashed/solid shape and explicit text as the non-colour signal.

### Validation commands run
- `npm test -- tests/connections/ConnectionDetail.test.tsx tests/connections/ConnectionLegend.test.tsx` → **exit 0, 10/10 tests**
- `npm run typecheck` → **exit 0**
- Additional checks: `npm run lint` exit 0; full suite `npm test` → **56 files, 748 tests passed**; `npm run build` exit 0.

### Shared-file handoff
- `CaseBoardPage.tsx` now subscribes to `selectedConnectionId`, mounts `ConnectionDetail`, mounts `ConnectionLegend`, and owns retype/delete/undo composition. Preserve the `connection-detail-title` ID — it is the focus-recovery target after Undo.
- Detail is hidden only when the LINK-3 type menu is open for the same connection; dropping that condition would show two competing surfaces after a new thread.
- `connections.css` now owns the detail and legend styles plus the existing type menu. The menu shadow was changed to `var(--shadow-panel)` to remove the last raw `rgb()` fallback.

### Known gaps / review notes
- `BoardCanvas` does not yet emit a string tap to `selectConnection`; the detail mounts when selection arrives from creation/duplicate or the store. Canvas string selection remains board-engineer scope, and the keyboard picker is explicitly deferred to LINK-5.
- Component tests run in jsdom at its default 1024×768 window; the responsive CSS stacks below 64rem and uses a side column at ≥64rem, but no real-browser viewport or tablet board-feel pass was run here. That remains for LINK-HR-1.
